slides.title:
Keeps tightening
straight back up?
slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Toto has been grinding one calf on the foam roller for ten minutes, teeth clenched. Surely more pain means more benefit?

Foam rolling is quick, cheap and easy to do daily, and many people find it helps them feel looser. Firm but comfortable pressure, 30–60 seconds per area, with slow breathing, is plenty.

A remedial massage therapist can assess and target specific areas, adjust pressure as they go, and reach spots that are hard to roll, like the neck and between the shoulder blades. Neither replaces strength work and gradual training; think of them as helpful add-ons.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can show you where to roll at home. Book online via the link in bio.
